cohort: 60 women with obstetric cholestasis and a control group (n not specified)
finding: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) occurred in 7.21% of deliveries, and was associated with higher rates of preeclampsia, preterm delivery, and meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in the ICP group (41.7%) compared to controls (23.3%).
